fields.title: [memory-api] Support cross-git-worktree (submodule) entity moves
fields.validation_summary: Contract decision: sequential cross-worktree moves fail-close on DirtyTrackedFiles from prior move rewrites unless the prior move is committed or rolled back. Added focused ticket-api tests covering execute/resume/rollback behavior: sequential_move_requires_commit_or_rollback_between_executes; sequential_move_after_resumed_execution_is_blocked_until_clean; rollback_clears_rewrites_and_unblocks_next_sequential_move. Validation: rtk cargo test -p ticket-api sequential_move_requires_commit_or_rollback_between_executes -- --nocapture; rtk cargo test -p ticket-api sequential_move_after_resumed_execution_is_blocked_until_clean -- --nocapture; rtk cargo test -p ticket-api rollback_clears_rewrites_and_unblocks_next_sequential_move -- --nocapture.
